notes.title: Letters From a Rainy Day 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes:
On June 30, Letters From a Rainy Day  celebrated its first anniversary!
An illustration for the first anniversary has come from the original artist, sheepD.

Thank you very much for your nice reviews and comments.
The game is currently on sale for 25% off during the Steam Summer Sale.
We hope you enjoy it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40633700/80016c45ec80003372f25efbc109c4cc70e96a49.png[/img]

notes.title: Added high-quality sound data to the soundtrack.
notes.notes: High-quality sound data in FLAC format was added to the original soundtrack.

notes.title: Today, August 11, is Mikoto Kurahashi's birthday!
notes.notes:
Today, August 11, is Mikoto Kurahashi's birthday!
sheepD has drawn this image in celebration.
Join us in wishing her a very happy birthday!

We hope you enjoy the game too!
Letters From a Rainy Day -Oceans and Lace- is available now on Steam.
